message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) was one of the bloodiest single-day engagements of the Napoleonic Wars.  Roughly **23 000–25 000 soldiers** were killed, wounded, or taken prisoner in total:

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French & allied (Bourbon & German) | 25 000 (≈ 12 000 killed, 10 000 wounded, 3 000 missing) |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian coalition | 22 000 (≈ 8 000 killed, 12 000 wounded, 2 000 missing) |

These figures vary slightly among sources, but most historians agree on a total casualty count in the mid‑20s of thousands.
